attractions.name: Uluwatu Temple
attractions.description: Important Balinese sea temple perched on sheer cliffs above the Indian Ocean.
attractions.recommended_duration: About 60 minutes before the Kecak dance
attractions.dress_code: Shoulders and knees covered; sarong required
tips: Macaques snatch loose items such as sunglasses, hats and phones
Stay on marked paths and away from cliff edges

attractions.name: Kecak Fire Dance at Uluwatu Amphitheater
attractions.description: Performance featuring a hypnotic chorus of chanting men, fire effects and the Ramayana tale against a sunset backdrop.
tips: Arrive early (by 5:30 PM) for good seats

attractions.name: Kecak Fire Dance at Uluwatu
attractions.description: Performance with a large male chorus chanting rhythmic patterns, telling scenes from the Ramayana against the sunset; about 2 min from Uluwatu Temple.
tips: Performances generally begin around 6:00 PM, subject to change
Very popular; be seated well before it begins
Don't arrive at the last minute
